run.change_description: lib/batcher: prevent commits racing shutdown - fixes #9687

summary.intent: Serialize Batcher.Commit admission with insertion of the shutdown marker so every accepted request is processed before the commit loop quits, and later Commits get the existing shutdown error.

tasks.premise: Every admitted Commit request is enqueued on b.in before the quit marker and a Commit after shutdown starts observes b.closed under admitMu and is rejected.

The change adds no deadlock: commitLoop keeps draining b.in until quit, quit is sent only after close(b.closed) under admitMu, and no path re-enters admitMu or calls Shutdown or Commit while holding it.
